items.title_zh: 数以千计的死于美以美军对伊朗的战争,
items.summary: Thousands of people have been killed across the Middle East since the US-Israeli war with Iran began in February, official figures show, with a deal now agreed to end the war.
items.summary_zh: 官方数字显示,自从2月美以战争开始以来,中东各地有上千人被杀死,现在达成协议结束战争。

items.title: What Iran and US get from deal and why both could struggle to keep it
items.title_zh: 伊朗和美国从交易中获得什么 为什么双方都会为保持交易而挣扎
items.summary: More than 100 days after US and Israeli bombs began falling on Iran, both sides are claiming victory - a sign of how much each needed a way out.
items.summary_zh: 美国和以色列炸弹开始倒向伊朗100多天后,双方都声称取得了胜利,这说明每一方都需要一条出路。

items.title: Should the US impose a teen social media ban like the UK?
items.title_zh: 美国是否应该像英国那样实行青少年社交媒体禁令?
items.summary: The UK is imposing a social media ban for children under the age of 16. British politicians say they will provide an update on further restrictions like potential curfews and curbing of "addictive" features like infinite scroll and AI chatbots, in July.
items.summary_zh: 联合王国正在对16岁以下儿童实施社交媒体禁令。 英国政治人物表示,他们会在7月提供进一步限制的最新情况,如潜在的宵禁,并遏制"附加"特征,如无限卷轴和AI聊天人等.
